title: Two Gym Buddies, Two Bays Apart

beats.theme: the gym buddy commute: two friends drive separately to the same 6 am gym
beats.setting: the gym's car park at dawn, told through Rohan's smartwatch stats
beats.conflict: each texts 'already inside' and secretly waits in his car for the other to go in first
beats.failedAttempt: a 500 rupee skip-penalty bet that both lose the same morning, so the money just swaps
beats.twist: they were two bays apart for three months; the parking attendant knew and funded his own gym membership with their fees
beats.lesson: motivation is always late, a friend at your gate isn't
beats.appAngle: the roster names tomorrow's driver; one tap tells you your buddy is outside with the engine running
beats.callback: the parking attendant lost his two best customers and still out-lifts them both
beats.ctaLine: Gym buddy hiding in a car park?

lines.text: Your gym buddy could be lying to you every morning, and you'd never find out why.
Rohan's smartwatch logged ninety gym mornings. Zero reps.
Rohan and Arjun. Six a.m. Same gym. Two cars.
Rule one: never let your buddy work out alone.
Rohan parks. Texts: inside, warming up.
He is in his car. Scrolling.
Arjun parks. Replies: same bro, on the treadmill.
Also in his car. Also scrolling.
Steps: twelve. Calories burned: one banana.
Week four. Rohan's seat goes fully flat.
Week seven. Arjun brings a pillow.
Week ten. Arjun's car has curtains.
So, a bet. Skip a morning, pay your buddy five hundred.
Next day, both skip. Both pay.
Net gains: zero rupees, zero muscle.
Then the parking guy knocks on both windows.
Sirs. You're two bays apart. Three months now.
Their parking money bought his own membership.
Lesson: motivation is always late. A friend at your gate isn't.
So they switched to one car, on an app.
The roster picks tomorrow's driver. And one tap means he's outside, engine running.
No hiding. Both walk in.
Rohan's watch: four hundred steps. Personal best.
The parking guy lost his two best customers. Still out lifts them both.
Gym buddy hiding in a car park? Try Sahyatri. Link in bio.
